name: Ivan Mažuranić
bio: Ivan Mažuranić (1814–1890) was a Croatian poet, lawyer and statesman, a leading figure of the Illyrian movement. He served as Ban of Croatia from 1873 to 1880, the first commoner to hold that office, and carried through major reforms in education, the judiciary and public administration.

His fame as a poet rests on Smrt Smail-age Čengića (The Death of Smail-aga Čengić, 1846), a Romantic epic in five cantos about the killing of an Ottoman tyrant by Montenegrin highlanders. It is regarded as the finest work of Croatian Romanticism and a classic of South Slavic literature.
